answer: When the lotus and the quartz agree but the canyon says otherwise, trust the canyon: dates are harder to forge than names or numbers. The evidence carries a date, so a proof fired yesterday cannot claim to be a year old. No story crosses this threshold, only each banknote plate is a season of logged burin strokes plus a signed engraver record, which is what Copperplate engraver banknote plate mark engraved into the engravers hall requires. Raising one clone takes 87 POA and 20 minutes; keeping 509 of them alive costs 44283 POA and 10180 minutes every epoch.
